summary.text: Says Smith will work to make Oregon affordable by incentivizing job growth, supporting small businesses, and reducing government spending.
summary.quote: incentivize job growth in our communities, supporting local small businesses.

summary.text: Says Smith will fight for drug and mental health treatment and accountability to end permanent street camping.
summary.quote: David has and will continue to fight for treatment and accountability, and bring an end to permanent street camping.

summary.text: Says Smith will ensure data centers are accountable and protect natural resources to prevent costs from being shifted to households.
summary.quote: David will ensure data centers are accountable, protect natural resources, and prevent their costs from being shifted onto Oregon households.
